package_role: toolkit-independent WoFF Mate product identity and Windows application icon source

considered_directions.name: plot-and-ledger monogram
considered_directions.summary: An angular plotted W and columnar M use a central registry rule to join route planning with administrative record keeping.

considered_directions.name: dispatch-tab letterform
considered_directions.summary: A clipped filing-tab silhouette was restrained but too generic and depended too heavily on an enclosing tile.

considered_directions.name: aerial-route monoline
considered_directions.summary: A single route line was simple, but risked reading as a literal aircraft trajectory and lost the product name relationship at small sizes.

q0.core_identity_concept: WoFF Mate as the operational companion where plotted activity becomes an orderly, readable record.
q0.primary_visual_metaphor: A plotted angular route paired with ledger columns, expressed as an original WM monogram.
q0.wordmark_symbol_relationship: The wordmark repeats the WM geometry, rounded line ends, clipped drafting-letter construction, central rule, and terminal register square used by the compact symbol.
q0.operations_room_1917_relationship: Plotting-table geometry, registry rules, restrained ink and brass, and drafting-like custom lettering carry period atmosphere without artificial aging.
q0.monochrome_rationale: Silhouette, letter construction, spacing, and the WM relationship carry recognition; brass is optional and never required.
q0.similarity_avoidance: No aircraft, wing, feather, wreath, shield, crown, ribbon, medal, roundel, service letters, squadron form, or heraldic enclosure is used.
q0.small_size_simplification: One small optical master widens WM strokes and counters and removes the inset brass border for targets through 40 px.

theme_contract.dark_on_light: #201D18 on V2 paper or another verified light surface
theme_contract.light_on_dark: #F4EFE2 on V2 shell or another verified dark surface
theme_contract.limited_color: #F4EFE2 geometry with #C2A86B registry accents on #18231F where a self-contained tile is required
theme_contract.recognition: Color is optional and never carries product identity alone.
theme_contract.status_boundary: Brand colors do not encode information, success, warning, error, stale, or unavailable state.

usage.wordmark_clear_space: one symbol divider width (16/256 symbol units)
usage.app_icon_safe_area: critical WM geometry stays within the central 75%
usage.dark_surface: Use the light or limited-color variant.
prohibited_transformations: adding gradients, shadows, bevels, distress, outlines, wings, wreaths, shields, crowns, ribbons, medals, or roundels
using semantic status colors as brand colors

windows_icon.background_decision: An opaque aviation-shell tile inside transparent rounded corners provides stable contrast across unknown Windows backgrounds and is optically clearer than a free-standing light or dark monogram.
windows_icon.safe_area: The tile remains inside 7% outer margins; critical WM geometry remains inside the central 75% after optical review.

optical_variants.reason: wider strokes, larger counters, and no inset border

windows_icon.future_issue_82_consumption: Issue #82 should consume woff_mate_app.ico for PyInstaller and use the canonical and small SVG masters to diagnose packaged shortcut, taskbar, window-icon, and DPI behavior.

shared_accessibility: Wordmark and symbol are product identifiers, not substitutes for an accessible product name. Consumers provide WoFF Mate as visible or accessible text where the surrounding control or window requires it.
prohibited_domain_uses: pilot face or individual pilot identity
rank insignia, qualification wing, medal, ribbon, or decoration
national roundel, service emblem, or historical military authority
warning, error, success, stale, unavailable, or other UI state
